claims.statement: Stable chronic beta blockade is generally continued perioperatively when current clinical circumstances permit.
claims.limitation: A medication list does not establish actual chronic exposure; current tolerance matters.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adult general-surgery perioperative clinic or outside-hospital chart-review case; exact eligibility is in the mapped question.

claims.statement: A beta blocker should not be newly started on the operative day solely for perioperative risk reduction; a new indication needs time for tolerability assessment.
claims.limitation: One primary guideline; no exact dose or mandatory lead-in interval prescribed.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adult general-surgery perioperative clinic or outside-hospital chart-review case; exact eligibility is in the mapped question.

claims.statement: For the represented AF indication requiring warfarin interruption, routine therapeutic heparin bridging is not recommended.
claims.limitation: Does not resolve mechanical-valve, recent-embolism or exceptional-risk cases.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adult general-surgery perioperative clinic or outside-hospital chart-review case; exact eligibility is in the mapped question.

claims.statement: Surgical VTE prophylaxis and therapeutic bridging during chronic anticoagulant interruption address distinct indications.
claims.limitation: Exact timing and overlap follow the treating team; no simultaneous therapeutic plus prophylactic heparin prescribed.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adult general-surgery perioperative clinic or outside-hospital chart-review case; exact eligibility is in the mapped question.

claims.statement: For a major surgical patient at high current bleeding risk, mechanical VTE prevention may be favored while bleeding risk is reassessed.
claims.limitation: Conditional and patient-specific; prevention does not treat established VTE.
claims.applicablePopulation: Adult general-surgery perioperative clinic or outside-hospital chart-review case; exact eligibility is in the mapped question.

claims.statement: After bleeding risk subsides, a continuing major-surgery VTE indication should be reassessed for pharmacologic prevention rather than carrying forward an initial contraindication.
